card.text: The Pleiades is an open star cluster surrounded by reflection nebulosity.

introduction.text: The Pleiades is an open star cluster surrounded by reflection nebulosity. Its stars lie about 136 parsecs away; the dust may not.

sources.label: Melis et al. (2014), A VLBI Resolution of the Pleiades Distance Controversy
